title: Village Cleansing
events: The entire village drops Atetoh at the palace square. After 7 days, it will be used for village purification.
Kwihfo in all-night communication with the Ancestors.

title: Opening & Cultural Cleansing (The Awakening)
events: 6:00 AM - Campfire across the seven hills of Nsongwa announcing the dawn of the jubilee.
7:00 AM - Sacred cleansing and purification rites by the Fon and Kwihfo at the palace shrines (Tap Tap).

8:00 AM - Arrival of the population and dignitaries (Religious, Traditional, Administrative, Municipal Authorities, Courts, Parliament, City Mayor, Senior Divisional Officer, Brigadier General, Vice Chancellor, Public Independent Conciliator, and Regional Assembly delegation).
10:00 AM - Arrival of the Governor of the North West Region / Minister of Arts and Culture / MINAT.
11:00 AM - Royal Procession (Lerère), Anthems, Ecumenical Prayer, Welcome by Prince Nathan Asanji, and Cake Cutting.
Speeches & Cultural Displays: Welcome Speech by NTC Chairman, Speech by HRM Fo’o Ngwadeza III, President of the House of Chiefs, Governor/Minister, Awards, Twin Dance, and Fumben Dance.
3:00 PM - Magazine/Museum Launch by the Mayor of BCC / Mayor of Bamenda II, followed by musical entertainment by Cameroonian Artists.
6:00 PM - Traditional campfire lighting and evening storytelling sessions (Njallah) with village elders.

title: Ecumenical Day (Prayers for Peace & Unity)
events: 09:00 AM - Joint inter-denominational prayers for peace, unity, and the health of HRM Fo’o Ngwadeza III.
12:00 PM - Choral music competition featuring local, regional, and church choirs.
03:00 PM - Royal charity visit with thanksgiving and food supplies for underprivileged and displaced families.

title: Education & Youth Empowerment Day
events: 09:00 AM - Inter-school cultural quizzes, debates, and essay competition on Ngemba history and language preservation.
03:00 PM - Handover of school supplies, academic scholarships, and prizes by the NDECA Education Committee.

title: Health Wellness Drive
events: 08:00 AM - Free medical screening campaign at the Nsongwa Palace (consultations, eye tests, blood pressure, diabetes) coordinated by the Mary Alieh Foundation.
10:00 AM - Public health sensitization seminar on preventive medicine, hygiene, and clean water.

title: Sports, Health & Traditional Wrestling
events: 08:00 AM - Conclude free medical screenings and distribute medications.
10:00 AM - Traditional wrestling matches and tug-of-war between quarters.
02:00 PM - Kick-off of the Fo’o Ngwadeza III Silver Jubilee Football Tournament (Semi-Finals).

title: Women Empowerment & Culinary Arts Day
events: 09:00 AM - General Assembly of all Nsongwa Women’s Cultural groups, Mothers’ Union, and dance groups.
11:00 AM - Traditional culinary competition featuring authentic Ngeumba dishes (Achu, yellow/black soup, Akwa).
02:00 PM - Seminar on micro-trade, financial literacy, and cooperative management.

title: Arts, Craft & Museum Launching
events: 09:00 AM - Exhibition of traditional wood carvings, royal garments, pottery, and beadwork.
11:30 AM - Symposium: “Preserving the Nsongwa-Ngemba identity in a Digital World.”
02:00 PM - NEUKWI RITES.

title: Diaspora Homecoming & Welcoming Rites
events: 10:00 AM - Arrival and welcoming ceremony for Nsongwa elites returning from the USA, Europe, South Africa, UAE, and national cities.
01:00 PM - Town hall session on diaspora investment for infrastructure and sustainable development.
07:00 PM - Traditional night reception and dinner hosted by the Palace.

title: Sports Finals & Corporate Activation Day
events: 10:00 AM - Corporate exhibition hours and activation by headline partners (MTN, UBA, Orange, Ecobank, UCB, Boissons du Cameroun, Camtel, UBC, Credit Unions, etc.).
03:00 PM - Grand Finale of the Football Tournament.
05:30 PM - Trophy presentation and corporate networking evening.

title: General Assembly & Developmental Blueprint
events: 09:00 AM - NDECA Annual General Assembly: Review of community achievements and infrastructure evaluation.
12:00 PM - Traditional Decorations and Recognitions.
01:00 PM - Launch of Nsongwa 2027/2028 Vision (Clean water, electricity expansion, road networks).

title: End of Neukwi - Convocation of Dignitaries & Visiting Fons
events: 10:00 AM - Official arrival, reception, and traditional protocol welcoming of visiting Fons from across the Northwest and Cameroon.
10:30 AM - Arrival of Administrative Officials.
11:00 AM - Royal solidarity parade and fraternal cultural exchanges.
1:00 PM - Private inner-palace royal banquet for visiting Fons and Administrative Officials.
